//: Routes the AOT lane is KNOWN not to render, with the reason and the work
that would close each one. Read by scripts/bench-lobsters (which stamps
the classification into matrix.json) and scripts/lobsters-report (which
renders it).
WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT DO. It does not remove a route from the
denominator, silence the parity badge, or clear the red banner. A lane
that renders 24 of 26 routes still reads 24/26 with this file in place.
The only thing an entry changes is that the difference is labelled as
declared rather than left looking like an undiagnosed defect -- an
unimplemented capability and a mystery are both failures, but they are
not the same kind of failure, and the page could not tell them apart.
An entry whose `route` matches no route in the run is a hard error, not
a warning: a typo that silently declares nothing is worse than no file,
because it reads as coverage.
`route` is the route TEMPLATE as the per-route table spells it, not a
concrete path -- the bench username and story/comment short_ids are
fixture-derived and change when the fixture does.
Entries are expected to be REMOVED, not accumulated. Each one names the
work that closes it; if that work is not happening, the honest move is
to say so in `status`, not to leave the entry looking pending.

declared_gaps.reason: inline `render json:` is not lowered for strict targets, so the emit answers this route with its html arm
declared_gaps.detail: config/routes.rb pins `get "/hottest" => "home#index", :format => "json"`, so Rails serves JSON here and the AOT lane serves the HTML page. The respond_to flattening ledgers the dropped arm as a lower_residue warning (src/lower/controller/body.rs).
declared_gaps.closes_with: the render-json monomorphizer: src/lower/as_json_shape.rs and as_json_writer.rs are committed; remaining is type inference for Computed pair values, nested-record and Array[String] encoding, the datetime offset format, and widening FormatBreadth

declared_gaps.reason: Markdowner.to_html is a raising facade -- the AOT tree ships no CommonMark renderer
declared_gaps.detail: User#linkified_about renders markdown at REQUEST time, so unlike the markeddown_* columns it cannot be precomputed. The facade raises rather than returning wrong HTML, which is why this route answers 500 instead of a wrong 200.
declared_gaps.closes_with: a Commonmarker/Markly facade over an iterative Node#walk plus the DOM surgery Markdowner does (h1-h6 to strong, images to links, rel=ugc, @mention linkifier); scripts/markly-conformance already carries vectors generated from the real gem
